rerun_reason: Correct reporting only: closed-position unrealized PnL and event-versus-intent diagnostic metadata; unchanged strategy, data, fills and response calculations
source_limitations: Coinalyze Binance-specific daily liquidation aggregate is trusted as the frozen proxy; revisions/publication latency are not independently qualified.
Hourly trade OHLC is also the mark-price proxy; intrahour path ordering and exact exchange liquidation mechanics are unknown.
Funding is excluded from all return figures; results are before funding and cannot establish net perpetual profitability.
Contract sizes, fees, slippage, maintenance and liquidation fees are approximations frozen for this development run.
S&P 500 close timing uses a receipt-bound next-NYSE-session-close proxy; historical release vintages are not verified.
OI endpoint sampling uses only the exact five-minute observation at H4 close minus ten minutes, with five-minute publication lag; absent endpoints are not filled.
Market shock clusters and overlapping holding components summarize dependence; neither count proves statistical independence.
This is a full-sample exposed diagnostic, not walk-forward, sealed confirmation, or live authorization.

independent-response-check-002.json.method: Reopened normalized H1 CSV, close timestamp=open+1h, checked each hourly path, equal within-event-cluster then equal clusters; independent Python arithmetic

rerun-equivalence-003.json.event_retention_note: Per-event arrays are not retained; event stream counts/hashes and full position fill/exit records are retained.

launch-001-failure.json.error: historical replay requires execution from the immutable diagnostic JAR, not a mutable class directory
